By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant to disrupt the opponent's strategy while buffing your own creatures, along with support cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, this deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain a strong board presence. With a focus on low-cost creatures and efficient mana usage, this deck aims to win the game quickly through relentless aggression.
